content:
Best Buy has now updated its massive 60th anniversary celebration sale with new discounts added. We're still tracking 25% off AirPods Pro 3, $120 off AirPods Max 2, and the lowest price ever on AirTag 2. However, today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break also features a massive $500 off the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro via Amazon, Anker's latest SmartTrack Find My Wallet Card dropping to a new all-time low of $25, and a wild 50% off Mint Mobile's unlimited 1-year talk/data plan at just $15 per month. More details below.

Best Buy updates massive 60th anniversary celebration sale with new discounts added: TVs from $110, up to 50% off electronics, $1,000 off major appliances, and more

AirPods deals get deeper with up to $120 off now: AirPods Pro 3 25% off, and more

After a summer full of ideal deals on Apple's newest AirPods lineup, prices have dropped once again on nearly every model. The sought-after AirPods Pro 3 are now 25% off, one of the lowest prices ever; AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation have also dropped to their lowest price in months; and AirPods Max 2 dropped another $120 earlier this morning.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $190 (originally $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (originally $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)

Super rare deal! M4 Mac mini now $150 off at official Apple Refurbished Store today

Update: This deal has sold out, and we will be monitoring restock closely.

While deals on AirPods Pro 3, the latest AirTag 2, M5 MacBook Pro models, and more have all been quite ideal, the newest M4 Mac mini has been extremely difficult to come by. With retailers like Amazon and Best Buy essentially out of stock, we just spotted an incredibly rare chance to score $150 off the 16GB/512GB M4 Mac mini via the official Apple Refurbished Store.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now selling the 16GB RAM and 512GB storage M4 Mac mini for $849 with free shipping.

Even deeper discount! 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro now $500 off via Amazon

This week brought notable $400 discounts on configurations of the newly released M5 Pro MacBook Pro as part of a one-day Apple deals event. However, we wanted to particularly highlight one specific model — this 2TB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is now $500 off at Amazon.

Amazon is now selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB RAM and 2TB built-in SSD storage for $2,699 with free shipping.

This is the $3,199 configuration with the upgraded 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU (the model currently $400 off has the 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU). Although this machine just experienced a price increase, it's still $100 below the older, lower official price.

Both options are solid depending on the performance you need — currently $400 and $500 off, the upgraded CPU/GPU typically costs an extra $200, but with our current deals, it only runs you an extra $100:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,599 (originally $2,999) 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB $2,699 (originally $3,199) 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU

We estimate this $500 discount will end soon, but we don't know if it will last through Sunday when this week's massive sale event wraps up.

Apple's newest AirTag 2 hit an all-time low this week at Amazon, but here's how to get one for just $20

Apple deals are coming in hot this week, with AirPods Pro 3 still 25% off and the latest AirPods Max 2 also seeing one of the best discounts yet at $120 off. Beyond some M5 Pro MacBook Pro models at $500 off, some of the more notable discounts are landing on its newest AirTag 2 trackers, with both the single and 4-pack returning to all-time lows — although you can grab one right now for just $20.

Amazon has now dropped AirTag 2 single and 4-pack pricing to the lowest we've tracked since launching earlier this year:

  • AirTag 2 $24 (originally $29)
  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (originally $99)

That works out to an average of just $22.25 per AirTag (4-pack), while the single AirTag 2 is back at its all-time low of $24 from Prime Day.

While the price difference isn't massive, it's worth noting that Best Buy's "excellent" open-box condition AirTag 2 single is also at the lowest we've tracked — you can grab one for just $19.99.

  • AirTag 2 "excellent" open-box $20 (originally $29 new) | Best Buy

Although it's only $4 less than Amazon's new unit, I'd personally opt for the latter, but it is indeed the lower price. Best Buy's new units are also seeing the same discount, so if you're already ordering to take advantage of its 60th anniversary celebration sale, it's worth checking out those options too.

Apple Watch Series 11 anniversary sale $100 off, Best Buy open-box deals from $254

Anker's new SmartTrack Find My Wallet Card (works with iOS or Android) drops to new Amazon all-time low of $25

Anker recently launched the brand-new SmartTrack Find My Card for your wallet — its first product to support both Apple's tracking platform and Google's Find Hub — and it's now dropped to a new all-time low of $25 with free Prime shipping at Amazon.

Anker's official EufyHome Amazon store is now selling the new SmartTrack Card E40 (works with iOS or Android) for $24.99 with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

This product first landed on Amazon at $35 last month, then slightly dropped by $5, and has now received its first significant price cut to hit a new Amazon all-time low.

You're now looking at nearly 30% off, matching the better wallet tracker card deals we've tracked this year.

I'm personally a huge fan of Nomad Tracking Cards — they start from $35, and the Pro model with a 16-month battery life needs charging for longer endurance, priced at $45. But regardless of which one you choose, I think everyone should keep one in their wallet or card holder. I personally never leave the house without one.

Anker's brand-new SmartTrack Card E40 has all the most important features, including wireless charging, and is compatible with either Apple Find My or Google Find Hub. It's only 1.7mm thin, with a ringtone volume of up to 80dB for tracking nearby — and of course, you can load it directly into the Find My and Find Hub apps to see its location on the map.

Mint Mobile now offering wild 50% off Unlimited 1-year talk/data plan at just $15 per month

Mint Mobile is now offering some seriously slashed Unlimited 5G/4G LTE mobile plan deals. While this carrier has decent deals most of the year, they're now offering an Unlimited 12-month plan for just $15 per month — half price, which works out to just $180 for the year for unlimited talk, text, and data. Even if you're not planning to switch your primary monthly plan right now, this price is low enough to consider as a backup or secondary iPad line.

While you can also find discounts on their 17GB and 23GB plans, the best option is the 5G • 4G LTE Plan: Unlimited/MO 12-month at just $15 per month.

  • Mint Mobile Unlimited 12-month plan $15/month (half price)

Per the fine print, you'll need to prepay $180 for the 12-month plan (which works out to $15 per month), but for anyone looking to switch carriers at a discounted price or add an extra line for other devices/as a backup, this is an extremely compelling deal.

You can "activate service instantly if your phone supports eSIM," which works with various Apple, Samsung, and Google devices. You can also keep your existing number and bring your own unlocked phone to the service.

Check out the deals page for more details.

Newest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro hits all-time low at Amazon with nearly 30% off (wired version also on sale)

As part of its late-summer deals on its lineup of Fire tablets, Fire TVs, and Blink smart home products, Amazon is also offering the best price ever on the newest wireless Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro and bringing back Prime Day's all-time low pricing on the wired version, with both down nearly 30% from retail.

  • Ring Battery Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (originally $250)
  • Ring Wired Doorbell 4K Pro $180 (originally $250)

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Anker MagSafe chargers start at just $36 this week with free shipping (multiple colors available)
  • Anker 25W Qi2 3-in-1 foldable MagSafe charger is one of the best options, now 35% off (matches all-time low)
  • Twelve South Curve Nano is one of the best-looking MagSafe stands I've seen, $27 (originally $35)
  • Twelve South all-in-one braided PowerCord USB-C charger now down to $16.50 (45% off)
  • Anker Nano 100W 3-port charger with 5-foot cable, today only $36
  • Woot massive PC deals officially kick off, gaming desktops, monitors, coolers, and more up to 75% off, deals from $5
  • This display-equipped compact SSD enclosure features power loss protection, today only $29
  • Razer portable 11-in-1 USB-C hub now down to new low of $52 (57% off)
  • Twelve South Find My-equipped USB-C wall charger hits all-time low at Amazon, under $37
  • Wow! These leather Apple Watch bands just $6 with free Prime shipping (75% off)

Amazon now has AirPods Max 2 $120 off in all five colors (one of the best prices ever)

This week's massive 60th anniversary celebration sale is bringing one of the best prices ever on Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2, with Amazon now offering $120 off in all five colors.

Amazon is now selling the Apple AirPods Max 2 for $429 with free shipping.

Compared to the previous generation that was also priced at $549, you can now save $120, the best price we've found from reputable retailers for new condition units.

Best Buy's "excellent" open-box Midnight black version is priced at $403.99 with free shipping, which is lower but probably not enough to forgo a new unit.

Apple released a truly next-generation AirPods Max this year, not just a new color swap and a USB-C port. Unlike the in-ear AirPods lineup, they won't be updating the over-ear version at next month's new product reveal, so this $120 discount this week may be the newest and most advanced option for Apple over-ear headphones for some time to come.

Only one other sale event has offered a lower price — earlier this summer's Prime Day, where pricing was $30 lower than what we're seeing today, but inventory was quite limited and unstable during that 4-day sale.

Amazon's best-quality Premium Renewed iPhone 17 Pro models $220 off today (matches Prime Day deals)

While the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is my top recommendation for iPhone deals, Apple doesn't sell its newest iPhone 17 Pro models there, and it looks like that will have to wait until after the 18 series launches next month. Amazon's best-quality Premium Renewed products have returned to Prime Day pricing, offering up to $220 off compared to new unit pricing.

Amazon's best-quality Premium Renewed products have consistently been the best option so far for unlocked iPhone 17 Pro deals. Not only can you save hundreds of dollars, but you also get 1 year of Amazon Renewed warranty and ">90% of original battery life" — Renewed and refurbished products on Amazon that aren't "Premium" only come with a 90-day warranty, and battery life conditions may not be as good.

Right now you can find 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models back on sale at up to $220 off — the 512GB version is $20 cheaper than what we mentioned previously:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (originally $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,179 (originally $1,299 new)

As detailed in yesterday's Apple Refurbished Store selection feature, you can get an iPhone 16 with 1 year of Apple warranty starting from $699, and a 1TB 16 Pro Max for $1,269 — $330 less than the equivalent 17 Pro Max, and $130 less than the 512GB 17 Pro.

  • Refurbished iPhone 16 from $699 (save up to $330 compared to 17 series)
